head: 6ed9ace3a92f7435f84c2f75f0084a03070ae2e4
scope: Persisted string unions, status vocabularies, and typed setting vocabularies observed in the Android repository. Values are case-sensitive unless future contracts explicitly decide otherwise.

vocabularies.name: SyncStatus
vocabularies.default: local on domain tables; pending on offline_queue
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Current writers use local, except checkout queue uses pending; no active synced or failed writer was found.

vocabularies.name: BusinessType
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Created and updated through owner setup and business settings.

vocabularies.name: LanguagePreference
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Stored as business preference.

vocabularies.name: Currency
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: No alternate currency calculation path was found.

vocabularies.name: BranchType
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Created and updated through branch settings.

vocabularies.name: ProductType
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Controls prepared-stock and cook-upon-order paths together with recipe production mode.

vocabularies.name: UnitType
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Display and product-stock unit; no conversion engine was found.

vocabularies.name: PaymentMethod
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Selected during checkout and stored on the Sale.

vocabularies.name: PaymentStatus
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Written at sale creation; no later transition service was found.

vocabularies.name: SaleCogsSource
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Assigned by checkout COGS selection and retained as a line snapshot.

vocabularies.name: InventoryMovementType
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Append-only movement classification used by inventory reporting.

vocabularies.name: IngredientUnit
vocabularies.persistedIn: ingredient, lot, movement, recipe, production, and sale-usage unit columns
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Compared for equality in production paths; no general conversion rules were found.

vocabularies.name: IngredientLotStatus
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Remaining quantity operations can deplete; explicit archival is also available.

vocabularies.name: IngredientMovementType
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Assigned when grocery inventory history is appended.

vocabularies.name: RecipeProductionMode
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Selects prepared production versus checkout-time ingredient costing.

vocabularies.name: FixedCostCategory
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Used for fixed-cost classification and reporting.

vocabularies.name: FixedCostFrequency
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Drives occurrence generation over a report period.

vocabularies.name: FixedCostStatus
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Archive changes inclusion in current report queries.

vocabularies.name: FixedCostPaymentStatus
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: The active writer creates paid; skipped is declared and persistable but no skip writer was found.

vocabularies.name: OwnerAlertSeverity
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Set at alert creation.

vocabularies.name: OwnerAlertStatus
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: TypeScript declares active/resolved while the schema defaults to open; repository queries account for legacy open records.
vocabularies.compatibilityRisk: Confirmed mismatch between the persisted legacy/default vocabulary and the TypeScript vocabulary.

vocabularies.name: AppSettingKey
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Keys are upserted; the branch-specific key has a dynamic suffix.

vocabularies.name: AppSettingValueType
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Controls repository serialization and parsing.

vocabularies.name: ProblemReportMode
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Fixed at report creation.

vocabularies.name: ProblemReportCategory
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Selected at report creation.

vocabularies.name: ProblemReportStatus
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Current code writes open at creation; resolved is allowed by schema/type but no resolver write path was found.

vocabularies.name: ThemeMode
vocabularies.default: system when no valid stored value exists
vocabularies.transitionEvidence: Persisted by the theme preference service and mirrored in Zustand.

untypedPersistedVocabularies.issue: No complete typed lifecycle or consumer exists.
Polymorphic vocabulary is not centrally declared.
Operation vocabulary is not centrally declared.
Nested diagnostic vocabulary is JSON rather than a database constraint.
